requestBody.query: Why are black bars appearing around the picture on my Satellite TV?

200.answer: Black bars appear when the program's format differs from your TV's. To fix this, press Options on your Bell Satellite TV remote and select Image format. Alternatively, press FORMAT and cycle through the screen format options.
